data.name: Sunset Street Ninja
data.detailed_description:
The Year is 1994 in the streets of Miami, and there lies a secret battle. Sunset Street Ninja.

Built with advanced movement controls, speed, and combat at your disposal, you will incinerate your enemies, the evil yakuza and ninja clan. You're a single ninja named Asura, and your brother has stolen your clan’s fortune to create an evil economic empire in Miami, Florida, that consists of casino hotels and the Yakuza who are there to assist him. Only have the knowledge and skills to stop him. This Game is a FPS Boomer Shooter Beat EM Up that allows you to have fast-paced movement in a large hub world, fighting ninjas and dismembering your enemies.

  • Pull in enemies with your chain attack

  • Use Fire and Ice powers with the AWD directional key stance to obliterate your enemies with the elements

  • combine slide, double jump, and dashing to accelerate at extreme speeds for SEEDRUNNING

  • use your ninja sword to decapitate enemies and regain health

  • compatible with UZDOOM and GZDOOM, as a GZDOOM game and IPK3
    fully modifiable game, make your own maps in ultimate doom builder, and other assets in the IPK3 with wads!

  • kick enemies away with jump kick and kick key.

data.short_description: Sunset Street Ninja is a Action platformer/Fps beat em up, with semi nonlinear progression and with a hub world and retro style graphics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: A 2.4 GHz CPU or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 197 MB available space
  • Sound Card: generally doesn't require a specific sound card
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: requires keyboard and mouse
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows 11
  • Processor: AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 197 MB available space
  • Sound Card: generally doesn't require a specific sound card
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: requires keyboard and mouse
